versions.content: For API Can_SetCanPnFrameDataMask Status: DRAFT If selective wakeup is supported, Can_SetCanPnFrameDataMask is called, and Length parameter does not match configuration parameter CanPnFrameDlc the func- tion call shall return E_NOT_OK. If development error detection for the CAN module is enabled it shall raise the DET error CAN_E_PARAM_DATA_LENGTH .
